final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean1 FROM status_avgs), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse FROM status_avgs a CROSS JOIN first_mean m WHERE a.avg_pulse > m.mean1), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean2 FROM first_kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.avg_pulse, k.avg_pulse - m1.mean1 AS excess1, k.avg_pulse - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM first_kept k CROSS JOIN first_mean m1 CROSS JOIN second_mean m2 WHERE k.avg_pulse > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM remaining
